basic_info.title: Sequence Length is a Domain: Length-based Overfitting in Transformer Models

method.notes: Shows transformers overfit to the sequence-length distribution seen in training — length behaves as a domain of its own. Grounds this project's L=16->64 curriculum switch as necessary (not optional), and supports the review's literature-consistent extensions: multi-stage length schedules (16->32->64->128) with LR RE-WARMING at each stage boundary instead of one global cosine spanning all stages (the observed dead-LR tail in Run-2-XL is an artifact of the single-cosine choice).

gap_analysis.whats_missing: NMT domain; methodology reference for length-curriculum design only.
gap_analysis.novelty_reasoning: Cited for length-as-domain evidence behind the curriculum design.
